name: HEAVEN ~ Tobenai Tori
source:
Main character loses his parents one day in a traffic accident and barely survives himself. After a few years he returns to his home town and reunites with old friends. Will he remain shut in himself?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-august-2002-ever17-out-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角有一天在一场交通事故中失去了父母，自己也勉强活了下来。几年后，他回到家乡，与老朋友团聚。他会继续封闭自己吗？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-august-2002-ever17-out-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
